mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, visibility, session_id, message_id, asset_id, asset_kind, asset_type, bucket, object_key, file_name, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, status, parse_status, extracted_text, parse_error, metadata, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO artifact_asset (tenant_id, owner_user_id, visibility, session_id, message_id, asset_id, asset_kind, asset_type, bucket, object_key, file_name, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, status, parse_status, extracted_text, parse_error, metadata) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{visibility}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{assetId}, #{assetKind}, #{assetType}, #{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{fileName}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{status}, #{parseStatus}, #{extractedText}, #{parseError}, #{metadata})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND ((#{tenantId} IS NULL AND tenant_id IS NULL) OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND sha256 = #{sha256} AND status = 'active' AND ((#{tenantId} IS NULL AND tenant_id IS NULL) OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND bucket IS NOT NULL AND object_key IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE artifact_asset SET session_id = #{sessionId}, message_id = #{messageId} WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status = 'active' AND parse_status = 'ready' AND ((#{tenantId} IS NULL AND tenant_id IS NULL) OR tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND (session_id IS NULL OR session_id = #{sessionId}) AND message_id IS NULL AND deleted = 0 AND asset_id IN #{assetId}

UPDATE artifact_asset SET status = 'deleted', deleted = 1 WHERE asset_id = #{assetId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status = 'active' AND deleted = 0 AND ((#{tenantId} IS NULL AND tenant_id IS NULL) OR tenant_id = #{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM artifact_asset a INNER JOIN chat_message m ON m.message_id = a.message_id AND m.tenant_id <=> a.tenant_id AND m.user_id = a.owner_user_id AND m.session_id = a.session_id WHERE a.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND a.session_id = #{sessionId} AND ((#{tenantId} IS NULL AND a.tenant_id IS NULL) OR a.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND a.status = 'active' AND a.parse_status = 'ready' AND a.deleted = 0 AND m.validity_status = 'active' AND m.role = 'user' AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.sequence_no > #{fromSequenceExclusive} AND m.sequence_no <= #{visibleThroughSequence} ORDER BY m.sequence_no DESC, a.id DESC
SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM artifact_asset WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND visibility = #{visibility} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC
